offer.text: New here? Fresh boots, clean hands, and nothing on your back. That won't last a minute down the shaft. Want me to walk you through your kit?

steps.objective: Open the newcomer crates on the pallet
steps.lines: Two crates on the pallet by the landing, both yours. Supply's got a pack and work clothes, Gear's got the rest. Click one to open it.
Pack goes on first. Without it you've four pockets; with it, twenty cells and more weight on your back. Double-click it in the crate.

steps.objective: Put on the Leather Suit and the helmet
steps.lines: Now the Leather Suit, jacket and trousers, and the helmet. Armour takes the edge off every hit. Boots too, if you've any sense.
Battery cell's in the Gear crate. It's your energy, the blue gauge under your health. Lamps and powers drink from it, and nothing down there tops it up.

steps.objective: Hang the lantern and switch it on (T)
steps.lines: Hang the lantern on, then T to light it. Light costs charge, so kill it when you don't need it. But in the dark, you'll need it.
Your weapon's in there too. Every hit trains its skill, K shows you how far along. C is your trade's own power, Q a quick dash out of trouble.

steps.objective: Put the drill in your tool slot (hold F to drill)
steps.lines: Last, the drill. Tool slot. Stand at a rock face and hold F. Ore pays, and rock is the only thing down there that doesn't fight back.
Well, look at you. Pack, suit, light, weapon, drill. Almost look like you belong here.

steps.objective: Ride the shaft lift down (G on the car)
steps.lines: The lift's the car in the well, up the landing. Walk onto it, press G. The Threshold's first. Stay in the light, and come back up with something.
